check_messages_acceptability: check a list of chat messages for violations like min words, all caps, greetings, exact match, and safety
create_acceptability_checker: create an AcceptabilityChecker instance with a custom minimum word threshold for crowdsourcing message validation
normalize_answer_text: normalize text by lowercasing, removing punctuation, articles, and extra whitespace for comparison
exact_match_check: check if a guess string exactly matches any answer in a list after normalization
review_violation_types: review the AcceptabilityChecker ALL_VIOLATION_TYPES to understand which message quality checks are available
